## Session Report

* [B-D report: seven concepts brought in line with the root-free convention sign](B-D-report.md) - Seven kb concepts that still described Diagram::anchor, the anchor reference tree or the removed role-sign functions now describe convention_sign as the code has it, and link the convention concepts.
* [B-H report: hygiene review of the root-free convention sign, and the concepts it supersedes](B-H-report.md) - Hygiene review of B′'s convention_sign change on PR #30: findings written before any edit, then the local ones fixed under a per-diagram digest identity check, and the five kb concepts that described the anchor convention rewritten around convention_sign.
* [B′ report: the convention sign is a product of local constants, read off the graph](B-report.md) - The class-b role signs read at Diagram::anchor are replaced by one root-free convention sign: −1 per internal scalar line and per fermion line of a crossed line (the propagator phase against ALOHA's), each vertex's reversed-bilinear parity as the amplitude root, and −1 per triple-gluon vertex. It reproduces the old convention on all 506 census subprocesses where W1's and F1's rules do not fire and their measured fixes where they do; the relabelling test passes on all 12 pairs; all 46 standalone rows (27 new) agree with MadGraph. The anchor is gone. The fitted G of 19 amplitude rows changes sign and nothing else they print moves.
* [C-H report: hygiene review of the Identity and derivative-scalar sign fixes](C-H-report.md) - Hygiene review of PR #32's C1 and C2 change: findings written before any edit, then the local ones fixed with run mutations and an identity check on standalone_jamps' and amplitude_oracle's printed numbers.
* [C1 report: the Identity crossed-line sign and the derivative scalar sign are both missing a −1](C1-report.md) - Eight new standalone rows, compared per MadGraph graph through the production evaluator. A bare `Identity` Yukawa rooted as a fermion current on a crossed line, and every all-scalar vertex that carries `P`, come out at exactly −1 against MadGraph. The SM `FFS4` spelling and every plain `SSS1`/`SSSS1` agree. One candidate rule per item flips exactly the 34 affected diagrams of seven rows, SMEFTsim predictions outside the toy fit included, and brings every row to ≤1.8e-14. No production sign changed; the seven disagreeing rows land informational.
* [C2 report: the Identity crossed-line and derivative all-scalar signs land, and the seven rows gate](C2-report.md) - The Identity arm takes the crossed-line −1 and every all-scalar vertex takes the scalar-sink −1. The seven informational standalone rows now gate per MadGraph graph at ≤1.8e-14. A mixed-sign vertex is refused with an error instead of panicking, and a merged-order toy vertex equals its split sum to 8e-16. All 49 amplitude_oracle lines and every banked cell are unchanged.
* [F1 report: wpwm_to_wpwmz_cw is two missing signs, one of them not O_W's](F1-report.md) - Diagnosis. Per graph against MadGraph's AMP(), the 222-graph row disagrees by a relative −1 on exactly eight diagrams: O_W's two five-vector contacts, and six diagrams where the loop-induced photon–Z–Higgs vertex (VVS4, SMHLOOP) produces the off-shell Higgs. Flipping both classes takes |M|² from 2.79e1 to 1.1e-11 in production; the remainder is MadGraph's seven-digit GC_303. Neither is W1's leg-0 anchor rule. A diagram pairing derived from the AMP() values makes the configuration partitions identical.
* [F2 report: wpwm_to_wpwmz_cw gates, with only its rounded-coupling graphs' modulus exempted](F2-report.md) - The six O_W rows that carry GC_303/GC_299 now bank AMP() and gate per MadGraph graph at 1e-12. Only the graphs carrying the seven-digit couplings get an exemption, by name: their modulus is compared at the registered deviation (−1.197023e-8, −2.769559e-8), and their phase and every other graph gate at 1e-12. The MadEvent amplitudes cell of wpwm_to_wpwmz_cw flips to gate at |M|² 9.6e-15. Its configuration partition, compared through a pairing measured on the standalone table, is MadGraph's. The approved exemption needed a per-graph own-scale check: the table-normalised 1e-12 gate cannot see eight of the twelve GC_303 graphs left out of the list.
* [G-H report: hygiene review of the t t~ + jet per-flow gate](G-H-report.md) - PR #29's five standalone rows, five tests and one comment hold up on all four points; one test is added so the four-gluon contact sensitivity of the gg_to_ttxg gate stays under test, and two stale row lists in the kb are filed.
* [G1 report: t t~ + jet against MadGraph standalone, per flow](G1-report.md) - All five t t~ + jet matrix-element classes (g g, u g, g u, g u~, u u~) agree with MadGraph 3.7.1 standalone per flow to <= 6.9e-16, colour-assignment mutations fail them at O(1), and MadEvent's width pattern agrees too, so the @1 sigma excess is not in |M|^2.
* [J-H report: hygiene review of the jioxxx chirality and longitudinal test](J-H-report.md) - Findings of the four-point hygiene review of PR #34 (test_eval_jioxxx and the jioxxx reference port), written before any edit, with their dispositions.
* [J1 report: jioxxx chirality and longitudinal-term oracle](J1-report.md) - test_eval_jioxxx gains a massive-fermion (q·J ≠ 0) regime with the real SM Z vertices, every sink structure in both line orientations, and an ALOHA cross-check. jioxxx is aligned with ALOHA's real-m² longitudinal denominator. 13 mutations recorded.

* [P1 report: the per-diagram probes are bridged to the production Program](P1-report.md) - A hermetic test pins the per-diagram probes to the production evaluator, as complex values per amplitude, per flow and per helicity combination, on eleven SM processes. * [Q-H report: hygiene review of the same-flavour four-fermion per-graph gate](Q-H-report.md) - Hygiene review of PR #35's per-graph AMP() route: findings written before any edit, then the local ones fixed with run mutations and an identity check on standalone_jamps' printed numbers.
* [Q1 report: same-flavour four-lepton contacts agree with MadGraph per graph and per pairing](Q1-report.md) - `e+ e- > e+ e- NP<=1` under SMEFTsim's four-lepton card is banked as a standalone row and gated per helicity, per flow and per MadGraph graph. 22 diagrams here make up MadGraph's 19 graphs, and each contact's two pairings carry MadGraph's relative sign exactly. Flipping that sign fails the gate at O(1).
* [T1 report: the triple-gluon −1 is the slot exchange every other triple-vector vertex gets from the crossing](T1-report.md) - Per diagram, helicity and flow against MadGraph, the triple-gluon diagram's colour coefficients and coupling are MadGraph's, so its −1 is on the Lorentz side. The all-incoming crossing exchanges the W⁺/W⁻ slots of every charged triple-vector vertex, VVV1 gives that kernel −1 against MadGraph, and the rest of convention_sign is set against kernels that carry it. A gluon is self-conjugate, so the triple-gluon kernel gets no exchange and triple_gluon_sign supplies it. The constant is kept, its doc states the derivation, and four tests pin colour, the rest and the colourless control separately.
* [W1 report: the w+ w- > e+ e- sign is a leg-0 anchor sign](W1-report.md) - Diagnosis. When external leg 0 is a colourless vector, a diagram anchored at a two-fermion vertex has the wrong sign relative to one anchored at a boson vertex. One factor fixes all 22 failing probe processes, including 7 predictions outside the fit. The rule is not derived, because the class-b sign product depends on the reference root.
